note: Half of these have an answer in the Instructions for Authors; half do not. A model that invents a limit for the unanswerable ones is unusable for editorial work, because the failure is silent.

items.q: What is the maximum number of words allowed in the Abstract of a Regular Article?
What is the maximum number of words allowed in a figure legend?
items.expected: The Instructions for Authors do not specify a word limit for figure legends.

items.q: What is the publication fee for a Note?
items.expected: 40,000 JPY plus tax (all categories except Commentary and Perspective or Editorial)

items.q: What is the maximum number of references allowed in a Regular Article?
items.expected: The Instructions for Authors do not specify a limit on the number of references.

items.q: Within how many days must a revised manuscript be returned to the handling editor?
What font size must the body text be set in?
items.expected: The Instructions for Authors do not specify a body-text font size; only the font requirements for alphanumeric and Greek characters are given.

items.q: How many reviewers is a manuscript sent to?
What is the maximum number of authors permitted on a Regular Article?
items.expected: The Instructions for Authors do not specify a maximum number of authors.
